# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.7 Route 2: Byzantine Pillars, Noble Houses, Civil Wars & Romanization/Union 2.0 (oe_bp2_). Generated by gen_byz_pillars_v97.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Country-scope scripted effects for Byzantine Pillars, Civil Wars & Romanization/Union 2.0.
# Zero diagnostic logging statements; zero temporary preview variables (PREVIEWVAR clean).

oe_bp2_add_auth = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ }
				clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_bp2_add_opin = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_public_opinion }
				change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_public_opinion add = $amount$ }
				clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_public_opinion min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Adjusts the strongest active noble house slot by $amount$ (negative to curb, positive to empower).
oe_bp2_change_strongest_house = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_bp2_strongest_house_slot = 1 }
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = $amount$ } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_bp2_strongest_house_slot = 2 }
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = $amount$ } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_bp2_strongest_house_slot = 3 }
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = $amount$ } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_bp2_strongest_house_slot = 4 }
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = $amount$ } }
	}
}

# Adjusts a distinct rival (non-strongest) active noble house slot by $amount$.
oe_bp2_change_rival_house = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_bp2_strongest_house_slot = 1 }
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_2 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = $amount$ } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_3 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = $amount$ } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_4 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = $amount$ } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_bp2_strongest_house_slot = 2 }
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_1 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = $amount$ } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_3 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = $amount$ } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_4 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = $amount$ } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_bp2_strongest_house_slot = 3 }
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_1 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = $amount$ } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_2 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = $amount$ } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_4 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = $amount$ } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_bp2_strongest_house_slot = 4 }
		international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_1 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = $amount$ } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_2 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = $amount$ } }
			else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nf_influence_3 } oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = $amount$ } }
		}
	}
}

oe_bp2_nudge_all_themes_loyalty = {
	every_subject = {
		limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
		oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ }
	}
}

oe_bp2_nudge_house_themes_loyalty = {
	every_subject = {
		limit = {
			oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
			has_variable = oe_tg_house
			var:oe_tg_house >= 1
		}
		oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ }
	}
}

oe_bp2_clear_zealot_commune = {
	location:thessaloniki = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cw_commune } remove_variable = oe_cw_commune }
		if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_cw_zealot_commune } remove_location_modifier = oe_cw_zealot_commune }
	}
}

oe_bp2_rus_opinion_shift = {
	if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MOS } c:MOS = { add_opinion = { modifier = $mod$ target = root } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = c:RUS } c:RUS = { add_opinion = { modifier = $mod$ target = root } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = c:NOV } c:NOV = { add_opinion = { modifier = $mod$ target = root } } }
}

# Strictly O(1) biannual dispatcher (called ONLY in March and September by oe_bp2_pulse.txt).
oe_bp2_biannual_dispatch = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_event_cd } }
		# Priority 1: 1341/1352 Civil Wars & Thessalonica Zealots multi-ending depth (BYZ only)
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_bp2_is_byz_host = yes
				has_variable = oe_cw_active
				country_exists = c:SER
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_done_11 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_done_11 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_event_cd months = 12 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bp2.11
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				oe_bp2_is_byz_host = yes
				OR = { has_variable = oe_cw_active has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
				OR = { country_exists = c:TUR country_exists = c:AYD }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_done_12 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_done_12 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_event_cd months = 12 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bp2.12
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_bp2_zealots_reckoning_ready = yes }
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_done_15 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_event_cd months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bp2.15
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				oe_bp2_is_byz_host = yes
				has_global_variable = oe_cw_jewels_in_venice
				country_exists = c:VEN
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
				gold >= 220
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_done_13 }
			}

			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_event_cd months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bp2.13
		}

				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }

				NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_done_14 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_done_14 value = 1 }

			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bp2.14
		}
		# Priority 2: Church Union 2.0 debate, Russian ripple & Pentarchy triumph
		else_if = {
			limit = {

				oe_bp2_union_active = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_done_23 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_done_23 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_event_cd months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bp2.23
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				oe_bp2_is_imperial_host = yes
				OR = { has_variable = oe_un_talk oe_bp2_union_active = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_done_24 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_done_24 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_event_cd months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bp2.24
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				oe_bp2_is_imperial_host = yes
				oe_bp2_union_active = yes
				oe_bp2_rus_orthodox_neighbor_exists = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_done_25 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_done_25 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_event_cd months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bp2.25
		}

			limit = {

				religion = religion:orthodox
				oe_bp2_union_not_active = yes
				location:constantinople = { has_owner = yes owner = root }
				oe_bp2_pentarchy_held_count >= 3

			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_done_26 value = 1 }

		# Priority 4: Imperial Pillars & 4 Noble Houses deep politics (BYZ + active Pillars IO)
		else_if = {

					}

							oe_bp2_max_house_inf >= 450
							NOT = { has_variable = oe_bp2_cd_2 }
						}
						set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_cd_2 years = 15 }
						set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_event_cd months = 18 }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bp2.2
					}
					15 = {

						set_variable = { name = oe_bp2_event_cd months = 18 }

					12 = {
